'''Pos Podura''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] employee of a small business firm during [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He attended the [[University of Sanbra]] where he developed feelings for one of his professors, [[Shreya Ordassa]]. He later attended an auction on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] with the hope of acquiring the [[Jewel of Yavin/Legends|Jewel of Yavin]] to present Ordassa as a token of his affection.<ref name="The Jewel of Yavin" />

==Biography==
As a young man, Pos Podura was a student at the [[University of Sanbra]], an exclusive academy where he was the recipient of scholarship, on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Sanbra]]. There, he developed romantic feelings for one of his professors, the Togruta [[Shreya Ordassa]]. Podura was aware of aristocrat [[Mil Mikkir]], Ordassa's secret lover, who recognized the student but barely acknowledged him.<ref name="The Jewel of Yavin" />

Becoming an employee at ThoraTech, a rapidly-growing technology firm, the Twi'lek learned that Ordassa was to attend an auction for the Jewel of Yavin hosted on Cloud City, a settlement above the gaseous planet [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. Podura, determined to acquire the Jewel of Yavin to impress Ordassa, stole corporate credentials from ThoraTech and, posing as a mid-level executive, evaded the auction's screening process through a combination of deceit and luck.<ref name="The Jewel of Yavin" />

Out of his element, Podura kept to himself, spoke infrequently, and avoided Mikkir, who was also in attendance. Reliant on numerous ruses, Podura was aware of the fragility of his position. He sought out local Port Town cantinas, using alcohol to ease his nerves, and sometimes drunkenly shared his story. Podura avoided repeat visits, although frequented the ''[[Four-and-a-Half]]''.<ref name="The Jewel of Yavin" />
